skill.name: set-up-magento-chatgpt-ads-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to prepare Magento or Adobe Commerce for lifetime value bidding in ChatGPT Ads. Verify whether paid orders produce revenue or profit signals before selecting a conversion in Ads Manager.
skill.summary: Set up and verify Magento lifetime value tracking for ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most scanner alerts are Markdown, documentation links, or normal setup checks. The review found risks from unconfirmed writes, broad order reads, unverified installs, and instructions that can expose a Conversions API key. The default destination enables broader data sharing than lifetime value alone, and one instruction names the wrong event for lifetime profit.

remediation.issue: The agent can receive and pass an OpenAI Conversions API key to a command.
remediation.suggestion: Require direct key entry in the Product Metrics app. Remove the agent credential exception and recommend rotating any key shared in chat or passed as an argument.

remediation.issue: The default destination sends additional events and matching data beyond the lifetime value task.
remediation.suggestion: Keep sending off until the merchant reviews the destination, data fields, event types, and consent settings. Verify denied consent with a test before enabling production delivery.

remediation.issue: Setup writes and retries lack an explicit approval step for the target property.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact property, destination, and planned change before any write. Require confirmation and check the existing state before retrying.

remediation.issue: Test verification can query the newest orders rather than a known test order.
remediation.suggestion: Use an approved test order ID and store scope. Report delivery status without returning shopper data or unrelated orders.
Pin and verify installers and packages from trusted sources. Review dependency changes in staging and keep Magento deployment under developer control.

remediation.issue: Live documentation and tool-provided browser links lack explicit trust checks.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer bundled, versioned references. Treat fetched text as reference material and verify browser link origins before forwarding them.

remediation.issue: The main guide names order profit as the event in the lifetime value workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Use the lifetime profit event consistently. Verify the merchant selected the intended event before reporting that lifetime value bidding is active.

semantic_findings.title: Agent Handling of a Conversions API Key
semantic_findings.description: The main guide allows the agent to receive the key and pass it to a command. The channel guide prohibits sharing it in chat. The key could enter conversation history or command telemetry.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The credential exception and conflicting app-only guidance are explicit. No actual credential or disclosure was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Destination Sends More Than Lifetime Value Events
semantic_findings.description: Setup leaves sending on before the lifetime value guide checks consent configuration. The destination sends other events and can include hashed identifiers, IP addresses, and user agents. A merchant may enable more sharing than intended.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The default sending setting, setup order, and payload are documented. The guide describes shopper consent checks, so this finding does not assume a consent bypass.

semantic_findings.title: Unverified Remote Instructions and Browser Destinations
semantic_findings.description: The fallback treats live vendor Markdown as equivalent to bundled steps. The workflow also relays tool-provided browser links without checking their origin. Altered responses could redirect users or change the agent's setup steps.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill explicitly relies on mutable documentation and returned URLs without stating verification checks. No malicious page or redirect was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Profit Conversion Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The main skill names the order profit conversion in its lifetime value workflow. The dedicated guide names a distinct lifetime profit event. Selecting the wrong event can direct campaign spend toward the wrong objective.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The two names are explicitly listed for different events. The guide reserves campaign selection for the merchant, so the risk depends on the advice they follow.

content.user_title: Set Up Magento LTV Bidding in ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: A first order can understate the value of customers who buy again. Set up and verify revenue or profit signals from paid Magento orders through Product Metrics.
actual_capabilities: Check setup status for a Product Metrics property through its CLI or MCP connection.
Guide a developer through Magento module setup, store view verification, and cron checks.
Identify the revenue and profit lifetime value events and explain their different cost requirements.
Check whether a paid test order arrived and help interpret delivery and consent status.
Guide the merchant through selecting the verified conversion in ChatGPT Ads Manager.
limitations: Requires a Product Metrics Pro property with editor or admin access, a connected Magento store view, and access to ChatGPT Ads Manager.
A developer installs the Magento module, and the merchant selects the campaign conversion in Ads Manager.
Values reflect observed paid orders from recognized customers. Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds do not revise sent events.
Lifetime value events require marketing and analytics consent. Profit events also require complete order costs.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Magento Store
use_cases.description: Check which prerequisites are complete and identify the tasks that need a developer before connecting an ad destination.

use_cases.title: Choose a Lifetime Value Conversion
use_cases.description: Compare revenue and profit signals, then confirm that the intended lifetime value event appears before switching a campaign.

use_cases.title: Verify a Test Order
use_cases.description: Trace one approved test order through the connected store view and check consent, delivery, and cost requirements.

prompt_templates.title: List Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need to set up revenue lifetime value bidding for Magento in ChatGPT Ads. Separate my tasks from the developer tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Current Connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for [property] and [store view] using read-only access. Tell me what is missing and do not ask for any API keys.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Missing Profit Event
prompt_templates.prompt: Check why profit lifetime value is missing for [test order ID] in [store view]. Review consent, known costs, and delivery without opening other orders.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Pilot Campaign
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Moving an existing campaign to lifetime value
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a one-campaign pilot for [property]. Compare revenue and profit lifetime value, verify [test order ID], and list approval checks before any live change.

output_examples.input: My Magento connection is active. What should I check before enabling delivery?
output: Confirm the store view is linked to the intended Product Metrics property.
Review the destination, event types, and customer data fields before enabling sending.
Verify that the consent banner records marketing and analytics choices.

output_examples.input: The test order shows revenue, but I do not see a profit lifetime value event.
output: Check that product costs and additional costs are available for the test order.
After completing costs, place a new test order with the required consent.
Confirm the lifetime profit event in Ads Manager before selecting it for the campaign.

best_practices: Enter the Conversions API key in the Product Metrics app and keep the Magento configuration file in approved private storage.
Verify consent, payload scope, and the destination before enabling live delivery. Use an approved paid test order to confirm the intended event.
Pilot one campaign and confirm the selected conversion in Ads Manager before rolling it out.
anti_patterns: Pasting a Conversions API key or private Magento configuration into chat.
Assuming the Magento cookie restriction notice grants marketing or analytics consent.
Selecting the per-order profit event when the campaign should optimize for lifetime profit.

faq.question: What does a lifetime value event contain?
faq.answer: It carries the revenue or profit that a recognized customer's paid order adds. It does not predict future spending.

faq.question: Do I need a Magento developer?
faq.answer: Yes. A developer installs the module and verifies that Magento cron runs. On Magento 2.4, you can import the private configuration in Magento Admin.

faq.question: Can I use revenue lifetime value without full costs?
faq.answer: Yes. Revenue lifetime value does not need cost data. Profit lifetime value requires all order costs, and a loss contributes zero.

faq.question: Which consent is needed for lifetime value events?
faq.answer: Marketing and analytics consent are required. The Magento cookie restriction notice does not grant that consent.

faq.question: Will the integration import my earlier orders?
faq.answer: No. Only orders seen after connection count, and the guide says events more than seven days old are not accepted.

faq.question: Who changes which conversion my campaign uses?
faq.answer: You select the verified lifetime value conversion in ChatGPT Ads Manager. The skill guides the change and helps you confirm the result.
